 Mr. K.K. Gaya, Asc
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with C.T case No. 376 of 2022, pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C. Kesinga, arising out of Kesinga P.S. Case No. 390 of 2022, for alleged commission of offences under Sections. 379/411/120(B) of the IPC.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Sessions Judge, Kalahandi, Bhawanipatna by order dated 17.05.2023 in the aforementioned case,
the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner has been remanded in the case at hand on 09.12.2022 and as charge sheet has been filed on 29.12.2022, his further continuance in custody is unwarranted.
5.

It is further submitted that co-accused namely one Purusottam Naik order dated 10.03.2023 in BLAPL No. 2152 of 2023 and other co-accused namely Dhruba Nag have been released on bail on order dated 08.06.2023 in BLAPL No. 5571 of 2023.
Hence, on the ground of parity the petitioner seeks release.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail in view of the criminal proclivity of the petitioner.

sentences.text: 7. Considering the nature of allegation, punishment prescribed and the period in custody, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

8. Additionally it is directed that, the petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional police station once a week on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till conclusion of the trial.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
